title: Solunar Theory & Major/Minor Feeding Windows
summary: Solunar theory proves fish feeding is driven by lunar transit (overhead) and antipode (underfoot) positions.
details: Major feeding periods last 2 hours and occur when the Moon is directly Overhead or Underfoot. Minor periods last 1 hour during Moonrise and Moonset. Plan your casts during these exact windows for maximum strikes!

title: Spring Tides vs. Neap Tides Breakdown
summary: Full and New Moons create Spring Tides with maximum water velocity—the absolute best fishing days.
details: During Spring Tides (Full & New Moon), strong currents flush shrimp and baitfish out of mangrove creeks. Predators stage at channel points to gorge. Neap Tides (Quarter Moons) produce minimal movement and slack water.

title: Incoming Flood Tide Master Strategy
summary: 1 to 2 hours before High Tide is the single most productive fishing window for coastal anglers.
details: Rushing incoming oceanic water brings cool oxygen and fresh bait onto shallow flats, river mouths, and reef edges. Predators push up shallow to feed. Position your boat or cast up-current so your lure drifts naturally.

title: Barramundi & Seabass Moon Tactics
summary: Best fished around New Moon and Full Moon during the first 2 hours of outgoing tide.
details: Barramundi love moving water around snags, rock bars, and mangrove drains. Use 100-120mm deep diving minnows or soft plastics. Pause lure near timber structures.

title: Snapper & Mangrove Jack Structure Strategy
summary: Target jetties, rock walls, and reefs during low-light Spring Tide hours with heavy leader line.
details: Jack and Snapper hit hard and instantly bolt for structure. Use 30lb-50lb fluorocarbon leaders, live prawns, or weedless soft plastics. Strike and pull hard!

title: Giant Trevally (GT) Topwater Popping
summary: Target high velocity current rips at headlands during Solunar Major Overhead periods.
details: GTs hunt in turbulent current rips where prey is disoriented. Work 160mm-200mm topwater poppers aggressively to create loud chugs and water sprays.

title: Live Prawn & Mullet Rigging Techniques
summary: Hook live prawns through the tail and mullet through nostrils for natural swimming presentation.
details: Never pierce the black brain spot on prawns. Use a Carolina running sinker rig so live bait moves naturally with current.

title: FG Knot & Essential Rigs Masterclass
summary: The FG Knot delivers 100% line strength for joining braid to fluorocarbon leader.
details: Essential for big GT, Barramundi, and Snapper. Combine with Palomar Knot for lures to ensure your line never breaks under heavy drag.

title: Barometric Pressure & Pre-Frontal Frenzies
summary: Rapidly falling barometric pressure right before a storm triggers legendary feeding frenzies.
details: Fish sense atmospheric pressure drops and feed voraciously before cold fronts arrive. 1015+ hPa steady pressure provides solid, predictable action.
